repos_data.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for ScrapeUnblocker - let Claude fetch any web page's HTML through your own API key.
Open-source MCP server for AI agents: web search, content extraction, and library docs -- 5-strategy scraping, runs without API keys.

repo_meta_data.description: Official MCP server for UnblockingAPI — read any web page (bot-protected, JavaScript-heavy, geo-blocked) and parse it to JSON with templates. Hosted at mcp.unblockingapi.com or run locally with npx.
